notes.DAL: Elon Musk said on 2 Oct that Delta CEO Ed Bastian 'will lose his job' over picking Amazon's Leo satellite service over Starlink for in-flight Wi-Fi; United is fast-tracking status matches to poach Delta elite flyers. Reputational noise, not yet clearly in the tape, ahead of Delta's 9 Oct earnings.

news.title: September jobs report misses badly; stocks rally on Fed-pause bets
news.text: Nonfarm payrolls added just 29,000 vs. ~90,000 expected; unemployment rose to 4.2%. Futures and cash indices extended gains on bets the miss keeps the Fed from tightening further, with the 10Y yield easing.

news.title: Morgan Stanley names Nvidia its top semiconductor pick
news.text: Morgan Stanley reiterated NVDA as its top chip pick entering a new product cycle. Separately, Anthropic and xAI have committed up to $84.5B for Nvidia compute through 2029, and the board upsized its buyback authorization by $150B to $235B.

news.title: ON Semiconductor sweetens Synaptics bid to all-cash ~$5.7B
news.text: ON Semiconductor restructured its pending Synaptics takeover from a $7B all-stock deal into an all-cash ~$5.7B transaction, immediately accretive to its non-GAAP EPS. ON +6.5% and SYNA +15% pre-market, lifting broader chip sentiment alongside Micron's post-earnings strength.

news.title: Musk vs. Delta: Starlink snub turns personal
news.text: Elon Musk said Delta CEO Ed Bastian 'will lose his job' over choosing Amazon's Leo satellite service instead of Starlink for in-flight Wi-Fi; United is fast-tracking status matches to poach Delta elite flyers. Noise, not fundamentals, ahead of Delta's 9 Oct earnings.

news.title: STARZ pulled from Verizon Fios after renewal talks fail
news.text: STARZ and Verizon failed to reach a renewal agreement, pulling all STARZ channels from Verizon's Fios platform as of 1 Oct. Otherwise a quiet news day for the sector; the FCC opened a fresh comment window on broadband permitting and LUC policy (replies due 19 Oct).
